facts.fact: Agence Gabonaise de Presse reports that the 4th extraordinary session of the Conference of Regulators of ARTAC, the Central African telecoms regulators' assembly, was held in Libreville on 20 October 2026, hosted by ARCEP Gabon, and set up six permanent technical working groups.
